validity.recommendation: Change Owner1 from 'General Petroleum Co' to GASCO (Egyptian Natural Gas Company / Egyptian Natural Gas Holding); drop the orphan Western-Desert owner ref.
validity.researcher_notes: Owner1 is recorded as 'General Petroleum Co' (GPC) with an owner ref (egyptoil-gas.com Western Desert reservoir feature) that never names this pipeline - an orphan/irrelevant citation. Every independent source ties this line to GASCO, not GPC. GPC is an upstream oil E&P company; the national gas transmission grid (Sadat/Dahshour and Nubaria/Mit Nama trunks that this line ties into) is owned/operated by GASCO. Two independent Official-Gazette-derived reports both name جاسكو (GASCO) as the executing/benefiting entity of the land-expropriation decrees for this exact 20 km / 42-inch line: almasdar.com/164809 (Official Gazette issue 283, 2025-12-16) and vetogate.com/5639977 (Official Gazette No. 88, 2026-04-21, 'Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company (GASCO)'). The gem.wiki-cited primary source is itself an article on 'what GASCO delivered in 2023'. Owner attribution to GPC is very likely an error.

validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, strongly corroborated. Independent Arabic outlets name it explicitly - almasdar.com (Official Gazette 283, 2025-12-16), vetogate.com (Official Gazette 88, 2026-04-21), dostor.org/5515490 (farmer-compensation, ~50% of works at Manshaet al-Qanater), plus masrawy/powernews GASCO-network coverage. Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas transmission trunk - it reinforces the national grid by tying the existing Sadat/Dahshour line (near Soleimaneya resort) to the existing Nubaria/Mit Nama line at Bani Salama village, north Giza, running NE parallel to the Regional Ring Road; not a gathering/process line. Commodity gas is correct. DUPLICATE: not a duplicate of any roster row - distinct from the Israel-Egypt (P3620/P3657/P7864), Cyprus-Egypt (P0473), Cronos-Port Said (P7597) import lines and from the New Fayoum line (P6686). SPEC: Length 20 km CONFIRMED by two independent gazette reports (almasdar 2025-12; vetogate 2026-04) - existing akhbarelyom Length ref also live. Diameter 42 in CONFIRMED by the same two independent gazette reports (existing petroleumfuture Diameter/Status ref is dead - ConnectionError - replacement staged in fills). Capacity is blank and no reliable independent figure surfaced; left blank rather than fabricated. CAVEAT: endpoints in the sheet (Solaimaneyah -> Giza) are correct but coarse; true termini are the Sadat/Dahshour tie-in (start) and the Nubaria/Mit Nama tie-in at Bani Salama (end).

fills.researcher_notes: Location [ref] was blank (MISSING_REF). Both Official-Gazette-derived reports place the line in North Giza governorate, starting near the Soleimaneya resort (tie-in to the existing Sadat/Dahshour line) and running NE to a tie-in on the existing Nubaria/Mit Nama line at Bani Salama village. Confirms StartLocation=Solaimaneyah, Giza and end in Giza, Egypt.

Existing Diameter [ref] (petroleumfuture.net) is dead (ConnectionError on re-check). Replacing with two independent, live Official-Gazette reports that both state 42 inches (قطر 42 بوصة) for this line - value unchanged, dead ref replaced to avoid an unverifiable citation.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Recorded Status 'construction' is still right and is supported by evidence NEWER than the sheet's 2025-08-30 LastUpdated. Dec 2025 Official Gazette (issue 283, almasdar.com/164809) approved implementation with construction specs and a 10-month timeline; April 2026 Official Gazette (No. 88, vetogate.com/5639977) authorized a 3-year temporary land seizure and ordered GASCO to proceed with property expropriation and pay compensation; dostor.org/5515490 reports farmer compensation ~50% complete along the Manshaet al-Qanater stretch. This is active, physical implementation (land acquisition + defined build schedule), not a dormant proposal. Caveat: it is early-stage construction (right-of-way acquisition) rather than laid pipe; no operating/completion evidence found, so no move to operating. Most recent independent evidence: 2026-04.

summary: P6685 Solaimaneyah-North Giza (GASCO, 20 km / 42-in gas transmission) is REAL, correctly classified, not a duplicate; status construction CONFIRMED (2026-04 gazette land-seizure/expropriation). Concern: owner mis-attributed to 'General Petroleum Co' (should be GASCO) with an orphan ref.
